messages.text: You have the most wonderful of smiles in the world 💕
Tumhare hath ki crispy aalo ki sabzi is the best!! ✨
You care very deeply for everyone 🎵
Start believing in yourself much more!!🏡💗
Be proud of the person you are🌟
You make my world a better place 🌸
Your cutu baby voice is the cutest ☀️
I want you to work on loving yourself 💓
You fill my heart with love 🦋
I wish we can go on a bunch of trips.
I wish a lot of success for you.
I wish to travel a lot with you.
I wish to learn how to live in stability and boredom with you.
